tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: What the maps contain, the price, imagery coverage and quality, how to pay over x402, and how a person can buy one directly. Free.

tools.name: check_map
tools.description: Lay out the map and report what it had to compromise on -- overlapping labels, truncated text, annotations off the page -- plus the imagery quality and what was drawn, so drafted labels can be edited. Returns no image. Free; iterate here before make_map.

tools.name: preview_map
tools.description: Render the map at screen size with a PREVIEW watermark and return it as an image, so the user can see the layout before buying. Same request as make_map. Free.

tools.name: make_map
tools.description: Render the print-resolution map and return a download link. Priced by what the request asks for, in USDC over x402: Backdrop $0.50, Labelled map $0.75, Site map $1.00 (get_service_info has the rule). The first call returns the payment requirements with the exact amount; sign and call again with the

tools.name: check_order
tools.description: When make_map could not be paid over x402, it returns a card payment link for the user and an order id. Call this with that order id after the user says they have paid: it returns the download link and a mapId for free revisions, or says the order is still awaiting payment.

tools.name: revise_map
tools.description: Re-export a map bought with make_map, free for 7 days: change labels, annotations, styling or page elements within the tier you bought. The frame must stay the same -- address or center, groundWidthM, pageSize, orientation, dpi. Requires the mapId make_map returned.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "make_map" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
